notes.title: New Patch - 5/6/2021
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

The latest patch is now live, adding several fixes and improvements to the game. Thanks to those that participated in the beta! 

Improvements and fixes in this patch include:


 Introduced additional setting option which disables skip prompts during dialogues. The skip functionality had been retained.
 Addressed the problem of stuttering experienced on some setups
 Fixed the problem with hitting homeruns in batting minigame when playing with ultrawide aspect ratios
 Fixed the problem with Kiryu freezing when attempting to perform Charge Attack
 Fixed the bug with Fighting Stance keybind being locked to the LB after rebinding


Feel free to use this thread to communicate any thoughts and/or issues with the latest patch. Please be sure to include any relevant system information included if you experience any bugs – it really helps us pinpoint the issue.

As always, thank you for your support and feedback!

- Team SEGA

notes.title: Patch 2 Beta Open - 4/22/2021
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We have addressed a number of issues in the latest patch, which can be accessed via beta branch before deployment into the main game. This patch includes the below fixes:


 Introduced additional setting option which disables skip prompts during dialogues. The skip functionality had been retained. 
 Addressed the problem of stuttering experienced on some setups
 Fixed the problem with hitting homeruns in batting minigame when playing with ultrawide aspect ratios
 Fixed the problem with Kiryu freezing when attempting to perform Charge Attack 
 Fixed the bug with Fighting Stance keybind being locked to the LB after rebinding


To join the beta, follow the instructions below:

1. In your Steam library, right click the game and go to Properties.
2. Navigate to the BETAS tab and enter the beta access code yakuzapatch6
3. From the drop down menu, select “patch_omega”
4. You will be in the beta the next time you launch the game.

If you haven't been experiencing issues, we recommend not joining the beta.

Please communicate any issues that you encounter with the beta patch on this thread with relevant system information included – it really helps us pinpoint the issue.

As always, thank you for your support and feedback!

- Team SEGA

notes.title: Patch Now Live – 4/12/2021
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Our latest patch is now live. Multiple issues have been addressed including but not limited to: 


 Reduced CPU usage when not in focus
 Fixed phone camera issue not being able to take photos on certain installation setups
 Inescapable grab from last boss fixed (affected players with extremely high FPS)
 Performance difference in VF5 and Sega Arcade minigames when playing in 30FPS (now locked to 60FPS)
 Extreme Heat Mode keybind locked, now fixed
 Darts minigame throwing speed was different depending on FPS settings, now fixed
 Fixed the Sega Arcade game difficulty settings


As always, if you have feedback about the patch, please reply to the thread here. For everything else, please take it to the dedicated thread in the Steam Forums.

- SEGA Team
